preview: This episode follows a fast-moving story about a proposed charge on cargo passing through the Strait of Hormuz. We will look at the questions around the plan and follow the oil-price chart as the news develops.
comment_1: Listen for what the 20% meant and what was still unclear about the plan.
comment_2: So far, the key point is that the 20% charge was announced without clear details. Now, what happened to the plan the next day, and when did the oil-price rise occur?
comment_3: The 20% charge was announced, but important details were not clear. About a day later, the plan changed to trade and investment projects, while oil prices had already risen amid concern about a planned US sea blockade of Iran and energy shipments through the Strait. Next, listen for how the timing of that oil move fits into the story.
comment_4: The story began with a proposed 20% charge, then changed quickly the next day. But oil prices did not simply return to where they started, so let’s bring the main point together now.
